_comment: region.c create_gas_cloud() calls block_point(), cansee(), newsym() and pline() itself; trap.c chest_trap()'s poison-gas arm reaches it with no caller-supplied operation. A human Valkyrie breaks five wished mirrors (Luck -10, so chest_trap()'s rn2(13 - Luck) reaches cases 17-20), wishes for a trapped unlocked chest, drops it and loots it: "A cloud of noxious gas billows from the chest." and "You are enveloped in a cloud of noxious gas!", then waits in the cloud. Seed, date, character and inputs chosen independently of batch 10.
